feature_name: Automatic secondary index usage for Spanner SQL queries
summary: Spanner can automatically choose and use secondary indexes when executing SQL queries to improve query efficiency.
extended_definition: Spanner can automatically choose and use secondary indexes when executing SQL queries to improve query efficiency.

supporting_pages.title: "Best practices for using Spanner as a gaming database \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: In load tests, this model does an acceptable job of distributing the secondary index read and write load across multiple Spanner splits, as illustrated in the following diagram: Although the synthetic data used in the load test is similar to the eventual steady state of the game where Attribute values are well distributed, the game design dictates that all players start with Attribute=50 .

In order to speed up queries that filter for the game mode, consider the following index: CREATE INDEX idx score ranking ON Ranking ( GameMode , Score DESC ) If everyone plays the same game mode called 1 , this index creates a hotspot where GameMode=1 .
Because each new player starts with Attribute=50 , when new players join they are inserted in the same part of the idx attribute secondary index.
